recognize_zh: 這是 CORAL 研究的 Kaplan-Meier 無惡化存活曲線（非形態學影像）：復發或難治 DLBCL 中，先前未用過 rituximab 者（紅線，約 43–47%）的 PFS 明顯優於先前用過 rituximab 者（藍線，約 20–23%），p = 0.0029。
features: Kaplan-Meier progression-free survival curves over about 76 months
Red curve: no prior rituximab, plateau around 43-47%
Blue curve: prior rituximab, steep early decline to below 30% by 12 months and plateau near 20%
Most events occur within the first 12 months
describe_en: This non-morphologic figure shows Kaplan-Meier progression-free survival from the CORAL salvage study in relapsed or refractory diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, stratified by prior rituximab exposure. Patients who had not received rituximab as part of first-line therapy had a PFS plateau of roughly 45%, whereas those relapsing after rituximab-containing therapy had a PFS of only about 20% (p = 0.0029). The interpretation is that relapse after R-CHOP identifies biologically more resistant disease with poorer outcomes after salvage chemotherapy and autologous transplantation.
